Ruth, I couldn't set up the daily brief. The scheduler refused the request because the Gateway isn't authenticated for scheduling, so nothing will post at 07:45 tomorrow until that's fixed.

You're a member of all three channels (#strategic-pod, #strategic-random and #inc-vtg-hartford), so the brief itself would be fine to build. When it's set up, I'd post it here each morning. It would cover new messages since the previous brief, and I'd leave out money terms (rates, prices, contract values) so the figures stay with the people who are cleared to see them.

To get it running, someone with Gateway access needs to fix the scheduler credentials. Then ask me again and I'll create the job. Alternatively, I can post a brief by hand whenever you ask.
